rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_constrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.2, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=1, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=1.0, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-4 INIT_T lever (continue lowering), breast-native wavelet CONSTRAINED, val=200. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: init_t sweep at relax1.0: iter-2 init_t0.7 PSNR 16.5/RMSE 5.12e-2; iter-3 init_t0.4 PSNR 19.4/RMSE 3.66e-2 -- MONOTONIC improvement as init_t drops (prior over-injection is the failure). All hr=0, baseline PSNR 36.3/RMSE 5.21e-3. (2) FAILURE MODE: at init_t=0.4 the FBP embed still carries enough flow-time noise that the 8-step wavelet prior degrades detail relative to the strong 128-view FBP. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.4 -> 0.2 (embed FBP even closer to clean; minimal prior drift), relax1.0 fixed. (4) HYPOTHESIS: init_t=0.2 continues the RMSE-down trend (archived Mayo-prior best SSIM was at init_t0.2) toward the FBP floor; the prior becomes a very light streak-denoiser. FALSIFIER: if PSNR still <<36, the wavelet flow prior fundamentally cannot improve on the 128-view breast FBP even as a light denoiser -> pivot to dc_n_cg (stronger DC) and steps, then conclude the prior is FBP-bounded here. (5) BUDGET: ~90s/iter. (6) Loop continues; iter-5 on landing.
